result: Public frontend documentation reduces interface ambiguity; complete executable contract, validation schema/logs and financial execution semantics remain unestablished within this search scope.
source_summary: The public frontend documents on_bar once per closed five-minute bar, oldest-first OHLCV lookbacks, and a just-closed ctx.bar. It describes position helpers and long/short signals, confidence for router sizing, optional stop/target/horizon overrides, and None as no action. A Donchian example removes the last high to exclude the current bar; the helper implementation is not supplied. It names seven validation checks and consumes funnel, OOS, holdout, score and context fields. Full deployment is distinguished from an OOS trial. A fee calculator shows per-side slippage and maker/taker hints, not a validator fee ledger. The bundle links the official MCP repository. Its current Python resource reads local CREATOR_API.md and delegates reports to internal validation modules.
